name: mod06_position_prior_shrinkage
hypothesis: MOD-06's one live arm: shrinking the two player-value features (injury_skill_epa_value_lost, injury_defense_disruption_value_lost) toward a point-in-time-safe, data-derived position/channel prior instead of toward zero improves close-graded forced-pick accuracy over the production weak_stack profile, holding the reliability weight and every other feature identical.

reliability_check.reason: feature_arm compares two model arms (baseline weak_stack vs. candidate weak_stack_js_prior), not a per-entity trait -- no split-half is applicable.
